implementation_strategy: Hosted LLM API generation (gpt-5-mini via openai_responses) for intent→configuration; deterministic CPU-based verifier (vendor parsers + header-space/property encoders) for automatic pass/fail scoring; guarded condition uses a single automated repair prompt template when deterministic verification fails. All verification, contamination detection, repair, and scoring are automated and executed without human labour.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic precomputed manifest: 250 intent IDs deterministically mapped to emulation and production-like topologies and vendor strata; prompts and topology fingerprints frozen pre-execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1. Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 with one repair template allowed per task (per adapter contract).
randomisation_plan: Deterministic ordering and batch assignment derived from contract-anchored hash function recorded pre-execution; no stochastic random seed claimed.
caching_plan: Cache LLM responses and verification outputs keyed by prompt+topology hash; exact-match reuse only. Persist hashes and responses to enable reproducible replays. Cached items reused only when prompt+context identical.
failure_recovery_plan: On LLM API error/timeout: one immediate retry. If retry fails, exclude the incomplete pair from primary analysis (per preregistration) and log deterministic reason. On verifier runtime error: flag and exclude from primary analysis; sensitivity analyses treat exclusions as failures. All retries, exclusions, and deterministic reasons are logged with hashes.
result_schema: Schema 'paired_binary_episode_v1' records: intent_id, task_index, condition (baseline|guarded), topology_partition (emulation|production-like), vendor_stratum, model_call_count, verifier_pass (boolean), violation_types (syntax/local-policy/vendor-specific), repair_attempts, provenance_fingerprint, contamination_flags, timestamps, and artifact_hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: Planned: 500 hosted LLM calls to gpt-5-mini (initial + up to one repair per task). Deterministic CPU verification runs ≈500 verifications (one per episode) plus alternate-encoding consistency checks for flagged items. Execution organized into 5 batches to limit API concurrency; expected wall-clock <7 days under normal hosted-API throughput. All CPU verification and post-processing run on available CPU execution; no local GPU required.
